# ICurveSwap
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/curve/ICurveSwap.sol)

**Title:**
ICurveSwap

Minimal interface for a Curve pool's pricing and swap functions


## Functions
### last_price

Returns the last traded price for the token at index `i`


```solidity
function last_price(uint256 i) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`i`|`uint256`|The index of the token|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The last traded price|


### ema_price

Returns the stored EMA (Exponential Moving Average) price without recalculation

This returns the last stored EMA value which might be stale
Cheaper gas cost but may not reflect current market conditions if not recently updated


```solidity
function ema_price(uint256 i) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`i`|`uint256`|The index of the token|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The stored EMA price value|


### price_oracle

Returns the current oracle price, calculating new EMA if time has passed

More expensive than ema_price() but provides most up-to-date value
Calculates new EMA if time has passed since last update
Should be used when current price accuracy is important


```solidity
function price_oracle(uint256 i) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`i`|`uint256`|The index of the token|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The current oracle price|


### exchange

Exchanges `dx` of token `i` for token `j`, requiring at least `min_dy` out


```solidity
function exchange(int128 i, int128 j, uint256 dx, uint256 min_dy) external returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`i`|`int128`|The index of the input token|
|`j`|`int128`|The index of the output token|
|`dx`|`uint256`|The amount of input token to swap|
|`min_dy`|`uint256`|The minimum acceptable amount of output token|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The amount of output token received|


### coins

Returns the token address at index `i` in the pool


```solidity
function coins(uint256 i) external view returns (address);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`i`|`uint256`|The index of the token|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The token address|
